content.text: fo4flatvr: flat Fallout 4 in VR. Gesture and selfie settings apply immediately (re-read within a second).

VRIK-style gestures: hold a stick click, move the hand, release. Directions follow where your head faced when you clicked. A press without movement is 'Press'; out and back again is a two-way gesture. The right stick click no longer opens the favourites menu.

content.help: Master switch. Off: no gesture runs and the sticks behave as without gestures.
Gestures with the right stick click.
Gestures with the left stick click. The left click is also sprint: with this on, sprint starts once the click is held still for the button delay (as VRIK's button delay).
How far the hand must move for a direction (VRIK: about 11 cm).
The main direction must be this many times larger than any other, else the gesture is ignored (1 = VRIK, no check).
A press held longer than this is not a gesture.
After a gesture fires, new presses are ignored for this long.
Left stick gestures only: holding the click still this long passes it to the game (sprint).
How long an emulated key is held down.
A pulse on the gesture hand when a gesture fires (and on selfie on/off).

content.text: Right stick click + hand movement. Each gesture does nothing until you pick an action. 'Key press' sends the chosen key (with an optional modifier) to the game while its window has the focus, so it can trigger any game key, any MCM hotkey of another mod, or fo4flatvr's own keys (F2 camera view cycle, F3 first/third person, F8 recentre).

content.text: VRIK's selfie mode with FRIK's body: raise your hands above your head to put a mirror image of your body in front of you. While your hands stay up, roll your wrist to turn it. Raise them again to end it. It also ends on any menu or when the camera leaves first person. Needs FRIK-flat's body.

content.help: Raising the hands toggles the mirror body.
Which hands must be raised (VRIK selfieModeHands). The wrist that turns the body is the off hand for 'Off hand', else the main hand.
How far above the headset the hands must be (VRIK: about 26 cm).
How long the hands must stay up before it toggles.
How far in front of you the body stands (VRIK: 1.4 m).
Body turn per wrist turn (1 = the same angle, as VRIK; negative = reversed).
Wrist turns smaller than this are ignored (VRIK: none).
